translations.web: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.
translations.bsb: He prays to God and finds favor; he sees God’s face and shouts for joy, and God restores His righteousness to that man.
translations.kjv: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.
translations.asv: He prayeth unto God, and he is favorable unto him, So that he seeth his face with joy: And he restoreth unto man his righteousness.
